title: Respect the Community
summary: Treat fellow players respectfully. No harassment, hate speech, bullying, or disruptive behavior.

title: No Griefing
summary: Do not damage, sabotage, or alter another player's creations without permission.

title: No Stealing
summary: Do not take another player's items or resources without their permission.

title: No Cheating or Exploits
summary: Do not use cheats, duplication exploits, TNT duplication, or other deliberate exploit abuse.

title: Protect Server Performance
summary: No lag machines. Keep redstone and entity-heavy contraptions reasonable; follow staff performance guidance.

title: Farms and AFK
summary: Large automatic farms are restricted, and AFK farming is not allowed. Ordinary efficient survival play is not inherently prohibited.

title: Build Considerately
summary: Avoid disruptive or unsightly exposed builds. Conceal purely functional builds where practical.

title: Use Discord Responsibly
summary: No spam, scams, malicious links, or deliberate disruption of community channels.

title: Follow Staff Guidance
summary: Follow published RayCraft rules and reasonable staff directions. Ask staff if a specific mechanic is unclear.
